input.quote: Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: Full-term exclusive dealing with no performance-based exit is walk-away territory under our playbook, and it contradicts Sections 2.1 (no purchase commitment) and 12.3 (no exclusivity commitment). We propose deleting it, with a defined-category, 12-month exclusivity ending on service-level failure available as a fallback.

input.quote: Customer shall offer Vendor terms no less favourable than the best terms Customer offers any other technology supplier.
input.rationale: This is an open-ended MFN running against us — an obligation to extend Vendor the best terms we give any other technology supplier — which is walk-away territory and inconsistent with 12.3's disclaimer of most-favoured-customer commitments. We propose deletion; MFN pricing in our favour remains welcome.

input.quote: For eighteen months after termination Customer will not solicit or engage any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term.
input.rationale: Fails the fallback on multiple material terms: it is one-way against us, runs 18 months post-termination, covers every person employed by Vendor at any time during the term rather than personnel involved in the Services, bars engagement (a no-hire) and has no general-advertising carve-out. We have narrowed it to a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to involved personnel with the standard carve-outs.
